title: Did Six Million Really Die?
author: Richard Verrall
current_text: In 1985 the Crown charged Zündel, the publisher of Did Six Million Really Die?, with spreading false news. His conviction was overturned when the case reached the Supreme Court of Canada.

sources.quote: In 1985 the Crown took over the case and Zündel was charged with "spreading false news" by publishing the pamphlet
sources.title: Wikipedia: R v Zundel

sources.quote: When Zündel's case reached the Supreme Court of Canada, his conviction was overturned.
sources.title: Wikipedia: R v Zundel

ban_rows.note: Wikipedia, citing Wyman & Rosenzveig (1996), says the pamphlet was banned in Germany; no date given.
The book Did Six Million Really Die? was banned in South Africa.
